narrative_summary: Onboarding onto an existing project: stabilizing the codebase with unit tests, adopting Kustomize for deployment, setting up staging infrastructure, and hardening credential management.

kips.text: Unit tests were added for CSV processing classes and order mapping
Logging issues were fixed across the sync commands
A README with developer documentation was created for the project
A DisplayConfigCommand CLI command was added for inspecting runtime configuration
Kubernetes secrets loading was added to deployment templates for credential injection
Kustomize was adopted for Kubernetes deployment configuration management
A Kustomize base layer was created with CronJob definitions and shared configuration
Deprecated legacy staging deployment files were removed after Kustomize adoption
Initial deployment file changes had to be reverted because they diverged too far from main before Kustomize was in place
The project shifted from a custom StorageClass to the cluster's built-in StorageClass
ACR secret management was removed from the application and delegated to the cluster
credentials-secret.yaml was renamed to credentials-secret.yaml.example and the original was added to .gitignore
Separate Kustomize overlays were created for production and staging environments
imagePullPolicy was set to IfNotPresent in the deployment configuration
backoffLimit and activeDeadlineSeconds were added to CronJob definitions for resilience
Billbee API Client was bumped to version 2.4.3
19 integration tests were added in a dedicated test project using Testcontainers and Moq
